sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 18 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Sparse road-edge observations on pinned NC OneMap 2020–2023 analysis imagery, exported as RGB bands 0,1,2. Edges follow the racing asphalt at visible curb/paint boundaries, excluding broad painted runoff, adjoining concrete aprons and pit access. Open-connection limits and unmeasured intervals are interpolated estimates. Source raster spacing is not survey accuracy; banking is unresolved and rendered curbs remain illustrative

imagery.attribution: NC OneMap (2019), NC Department of Information Technology, Government Data Analytics Center, Center for Geographic Information and Analysis; NC 911 Board. RGB export and estimated road borders.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
